Services.title: Services
Services.intro: Available for freelance and project work. Four things I do well:

Colophon.title: Colophon
Colophon.p1: This site is a case study in itself. It was designed as a written spec first, then planned task by task and implemented with Claude Code acting as a subagent team: one agent implements, a fresh one reviews, and I rule on every disagreement.
Colophon.p2: Stack: Next.js 16 (App Router, cache components), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind v4, next-intl, Velite for git-based MDX content, GSAP + Lenis for motion, OGL for the hero shader.
Colophon.p3: Every animation degrades to a static page under reduced motion; motion code loads only after hydration, so the first-load JavaScript stays under 180 KB.
Colophon.p4: Quality gates run on every pull request: unit tests, Playwright end-to-end tests on desktop and mobile, and Lighthouse budgets for performance, accessibility and SEO.
Colophon.p5: The specs, plans and review ledgers are public in the repository.
Colophon.p6: Fonts: Cabinet Grotesk, Satoshi and JetBrains Mono.
Colophon.process3: Implementation by one agent, review by another
